verdict.rationale: The published bizfile pages describe online filing, search and ordering, but none document a keyless or file-number-only entry path for starting a filing without an account. The only access-related language points the other way: from August 1, 2026, web User Access is required for Statement of Information filings, and the online option is visible only to users with access established. Free online document images and plain copies are mentioned, but nothing says they can be reached without an account, and they are not the core filing flow.
